scenario: `t.date()` requires a timezone argument per LTIM.3.3.2 — a timezone-less local date is undefined. The compiler must reject `t.date()` (zero arguments) with DS_VALIDATE_DATE_NEEDS_TZ.
rules_ds:
schema Event scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    fired_at: Time mutable

rule trig:
    Event e where e.fired_at.date() == e.fired_at.date("UTC")
->
    log info "x"
